src: single solid green/pink rectangular sprite s
path: two 45-degree zigzag paths crossing at s; original-orientation copies recur every s.height + s.width cells on both diagonals, with rotated copies bridging adjacent originals
trajectory: stamp clipped solid rectangles across the canvas: original-orientation copies keep s.color and rotated copies use the other green/pink color
transform: output contains the generated zigzag bars on the background
